papers.title: BO-graphane and BO-diamane
papers.abstract: The adsorption of boron and oxygen atoms onto mono- and multi-layer graphene leads to the formation of a buckled graphene layer (BO-graphane) and a 2D diamond-like structure (BO-diamane) sandwiched between boron monoxide layers per DFT calculations. BO-graphane has a calculated Young's modulus ($\it{E}$) of 750 GPA and BO-diamane 771 GPa, higher than the calculated $\it{E}$ of -F,-OH, and -H diamanes; this is due to the presence of B-O bonds in the functionalizing layers. Electronic band structure calculations show BO-graphane and BO-diamane are wide band gap semiconductors with an indirect band gap up to a thickness of three layers (3L). Phonon dispersion and $ab-initio$ molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations confirm dynamic and thermal stability, maintaining structural integrity at 1000 K. The room-temperature lattice thermal conductivity of BO-graphane and BO-diamane is found to be 879 W/m.K and 1260 W/m.K, respectively, surpassing BeO (385 W/m.K), MgO (64 W/m.K), and Al$_2$O$_3$ (36 W/m.K); and F-diamane (377 W/m.K), and comparable to H-diamane (1145-1960 W/m.K), suggesting them as candidates for thermal management in applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索硼氧原子吸附石墨烯形成的新型二维材料性能。
summary_zh.method: 基于DFT计算弹性模量、电子结构和热导率。
summary_zh.result: BO-graphane和BO-diamane具有高弹性模量和热导率。
summary_zh.validation: 声子色散和AIMD模拟验证稳定性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the properties of novel 2D materials formed by boron and oxygen adsorption on graphene.
summary_en.method: Density functional theory calculations were used to compute elastic moduli, electronic band structure, and lattice thermal conductivity.
summary_en.result: BO-graphane and BO-diamane exhibit high Young's moduli (750-771 GPa) and ultra-high thermal conductivities (879-1260 W/mK).
summary_en.validation: Dynamic and thermal stability were confirmed through phonon dispersion and ab-initio molecular dynamics simulations.
